evidence: test_llama_architectures: CPU fixture llama (Llama 2/3, Mistral, Mixtral-style MoE) layout equals llama.cpp decode
test_llama_architectures: CPU fixture qwen2 layout (Q/K/V biases) equals llama.cpp decode
test_llama_architectures: CPU fixture qwen3 layout (per-head Q/K norm) equals llama.cpp decode
test_llama_architectures: CPU fixture gemma layout (tied head) equals llama.cpp decode
test_llama_architectures: CPU fixture phi3 layout (fused QKV, fused gate/up) equals llama.cpp decode
test_llama_architectures: CPU fixture mamba layout (recurrent state, rollback by recompute) equals llama.cpp decode
tests/backends_llama: decode equals llama.cpp on a llama fixture

limitations: Host only; middle stages are refused (docs/backends/llama-local.md). Distributed llama.cpp (RPC) is a baseline harness only, not an advertised mode (docs/backends/llama-rpc.md).
Listed architectures are exercised on tiny random-weight CPU fixtures only; real checkpoints (rope scaling, sliding-window variants, chat template, tool calling) and every GPU run are unmeasured.

Every other architecture the pinned llama.cpp names (153 in total) is Experimental: attempted only after an explicit per-model opt-in, never distributable. Names the pinned build does not know are Unsupported.

tensor_formats are the 28 weight types the pinned CPU build loaded and decoded in test_llama_tensor_types on random weights; that is a mechanics check, not an accuracy statement about any quantization.
Prefill windows longer than 32 positions return only the last position's logits (ADR 0300).

Recurrent state rolls back by recompute when llama.cpp refuses partial removal; this path is exercised on a Mamba fixture (test_llama_architectures), not on the Fast-tier model or any hybrid (attention + SSM) architecture.
Two interleaved sessions are tested (independent state); concurrent execution is not enabled, so max_sessions_per_domain stays 1.
The Fast-tier family entry (Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B) matches the user-editable family label because the model's GGUF architecture has not been inspected (HQ-FAST-01); no architecture is guessed.
CUDA build is compile-checked only; behaviour on the RTX 4060 Ti is HQ-TIER-01.

n_threads.description: 0 = automatic; still capped by the Host resource policy.

use_mmap.description: Map the GGUF instead of reading it; memory admission is unchanged.

qualification.label: Supported, awaiting hardware qualification
qualification.notes: CPU mechanics verified in CI on fixtures (architectures, tensor types, windows); no real model or GPU has been run.
